description: Source code for a tool named 'jboot_config_read' that reads and processes configuration data from firmware images, including parsing headers, verifying checksums, and extracting specific data such as MAC addresses and calibration data.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, reads input file, finds headers, and optionally prints or writes data.

methods.name: print_data_header
methods.description: Prints details of a data header including id, type, unknown, length, and data bytes.

methods.name: print_mac
methods.description: Extracts and prints MAC address data from data headers.

methods.name: write_eeprom
methods.description: Writes EEPROM calibration data to a specified output file.

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads entire input file into memory buffer.

methods.name: find_header
methods.description: Searches buffer for specific headers, verifies checksums, and collects data headers.

methods.name: jboot_checksum
methods.description: Calculates checksum over data for verification.
